sources.title: IBM i 7.4 — User profile parameter fields
IBM i — Using the command prompt display (F4)

asciiPanel:
Change User Profile (CHGUSRPRF)

Type choices, press Enter.

User profile . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > OLDVENDOR
User class . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > *USER
Status . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . > *ENABLED

Bottom
F3=Exit   F4=Prompt   F5=Refresh   F9=All parameters   F12=Cancel
F13=How to use this display   F24=More keys
notes: F4 command prompt for CHGUSRPRF — requires *SECADM. Full parameter set includes USRCLS, SPCAUT, LMTCPB, GRPPRF per Security Reference; lab implements subset for governance training.
